scripts.sync: bun run build && bunx cap sync
scripts.sync:android: bun run build && CAPACITOR_TARGET_PLATFORM=android bunx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: bun run build && bun run patch:ios-plugins && CAPACITOR_TARGET_PLATFORM=ios bunx cap sync ios
scripts.add:ios: bun run patch:ios-plugins && CAPACITOR_TARGET_PLATFORM=ios bunx cap add ios --packagemanager SPM
